generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Modular SHIRT piece for Santi Wong. Image1 approvedSanti is exact design authority. Image2 Captain shirt is isolated T-pose garment workflow/style only. Image3 bareSanti shows his broad barrel torso and belly shape for fit. Output ONLY his ivory chef shirt/jacket, no figure: wide round torso fitted over that stocky belly, open short fold-down collar, simple small buttons, sleeves rolled to elbows as in approvedSanti, clean gathered roll cuffs. Shirt hem at upperhip. Broad soft cream/tan planes and a few restrained ochre food-stain patches matching existing reference. NO photographic fabric fibres or tiny mottling.
Remove apron entirely, no apron bib or waist tie. Remove red scarf, leather harness/suspenders, belt, trousers, skin/hands/head, boots and cookware. These are separate modules. Not Captain frill cuffs, long sleeves or thin fitted torso.
T-POSE REQUIRED: both sleeves straight HORIZONTAL out to sides at shoulder level; same frozen3D garment pose across four views. Front/back full span of two elbow-length sleeves. Side elevations look down the sleeve axes with open cuff hole visible, torso thickness appropriate for belly. True hollow wearable garment with real collar/cuff/hem openings, no opaque skin plugs, no inner mannequin. No arms or body.
One horizontal row FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT, strict level orthographic cameras, SAME physical scale and identical collar-top and hem-baseline. Do not magnify narrow side views. Fully contained silhouettes, large white separators so every view can be cropped. Flat white255 no shadows floor labels text guides or otherobjects. Match painterly sculpted cartoon style of established character pieces.

source.postprocessing: Selected generated source copied unchanged; no repainting, axis stretching, rescaling or background editing.

dimension_contract.authority: Provisional art fitting estimates, not owner measurements or reconstructed bounds. 1.70m applies to complete dressed character only.

presentation.ownership_and_fit_note: Open collar, rolled elbow sleeves in horizontal T-pose; no apron, scarf or harness. Cuff/neck/hem hollow garment topology must be checked.
